avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inducer reduces aripiprazole plasma concentrations
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; may reduce antipsychotic efficacy

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Hepatotoxicity risk and additive CNS depression
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; risk of liver injury and increased sedation

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo Biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 induction may slightly decrease aripiprazole levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for reduced efficacy; adjust dose if needed

caution_supplements.name: Valerian Root
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for excessive drowsiness

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor increases aripiprazole plasma concentrations and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Avoid completely; increased risk of adverse effects including QT prolongation

caution_foods.name: Caffeine
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS stimulation may increase agitation or tremor
caution_foods.action: Limit intake; monitor for increased psychomotor effects

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression increases sedation and impairs cognition
caution_foods.action: Minimize or avoid; counsel on reduced driving safety

monitoring_notes: Monitor for akathisia, extrapyramidal symptoms, and metabolic effects (weight, glucose). Assess efficacy and tolerability if significant dietary changes occur, particularly with CYP3A4 inhibitors or inducers.
